Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D. We create the tools and resources our customers need to solve real-world challenges and transform industries, without massive infrastructure costs or the need to build large in-house AI/ML teams. Our teams bring together deep expertise across hardware, software, networking, data center infrastructure, and AI to build and operate the infrastructure behind large-scale GPU computing. The team You will build and lead the organization responsible for deploying and operating Nebius AI infrastructure at our Independence, Missouri campus. Your team will bring together data center IT operations, critical facilities, networking, logistics, operational readiness, and supporting functions. You will work closely with hardware, network, engineering, cloud, commercial, and corporate teams to bring compute capacity into service and establish reliable, scalable operations. You will have autonomy to design the campus organization, select your leadership team, define reporting lines, and establish the operating model within agreed budgets and company standards. You will own operational readiness and campus performance across critical facilities and IT infrastructure, aligning people, systems, and service partners to deliver reliable customer capacity. You will partner with construction, engineering, and critical facilities teams to align facility completion, commissioning, and handover with hardware deployment and operational readiness. You will establish the operating team and coordinate GPU, server, network, and storage installation, integration, acceptance testing, and cloud readiness with the responsible technical teams and service providers. Share lessons and operational improvements with the broader Nebius infrastructure organization. Experience managing multiple campuses or regional operations and transferring operating practices across sites. Experience building operating organizations and establishing processes during initial hardware deployment and the transition into production service. Experience using infrastructure automation, telemetry, and reliability data to improve capacity delivery and operating performance. review_candidates.description: Job Description The Role As a Staff Cloud Identity Platform Engineer, you will design, automate, operate, and continuously improve secure, reliable, and scalable identity services for a global enterprise. You will support Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Entra External ID, and foundational Azure infrastructure across workforce, application, partner, and external-user experiences. This role applies Site Reliability Engineering principles to cloud identity, including service-level objectives, observability, automation, error-budget management, incident response, resilience engineering, capacity planning, and reduction of operational toil. You will help establish identity platforms that are secure by design, measurable, recoverable, and dependable at enterprise scale. What You’ll Do Design, configure, implement, and operate Microsoft Entra ID capabilities for workforce and application identity. Implement Microsoft Entra External ID capabilities for external users, partners, and application experiences, including registration, authentication, federation, user journeys, and authorization patterns. Integrate applications and services using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, and other secure identity standards. Configure and support single sign-on, multifactor authentication, Conditional Access, role-based access control, privileged access, identity governance, and access reviews. Develop secure patterns for application onboarding, directory synchronization, service principals, managed identities, workload access, and identity lifecycle processes. Define and manage service-level indicators and objectives for identity platforms, including authentication success rate, availability, latency, federation health, provisioning reliability, and recovery performance. Establish reliability practices such as error budgets, availability targets, dependency mapping, capacity planning, resiliency testing, and measurable operational health reviews. Apply Azure infrastructure fundamentals to identity platform engineering, including subscriptions, resource organization, networking, Key Vault, monitoring, logging, resiliency, backup, disaster recovery, and governance. Build observability using metrics, logs, traces, synthetic transactions, dashboards, alerting, and identity-specific security and reliability signals. Monitor platform health, investigate alerts, troubleshoot authentication and authorization issues, and participate in incident response and on-call activities as applicable. Lead or contribute to incident triage, service restoration, stakeholder communications, root-cause analysis, and blameless post-incident reviews. Identify recurring incidents, manual processes, and operational toil; automate or redesign them to improve reliability and engineer effectiveness. Automate identity and cloud platform activities using PowerShell, Azure CLI, Microsoft Graph, Bicep, Terraform, or comparable technologies. Contribute to infrastructure-as-code, continuous integration and delivery, automated testing, policy-as-code, progressive delivery, change validation, and safe rollback practices. Design and validate high-availability, failover, recovery, and business-continuity patterns for identity services and critical dependencies. Maintain runbooks, playbooks, service documentation, troubleshooting guides, architecture records, and operational readiness checklists. Partner with cybersecurity, infrastructure, application, architecture, privacy, compliance, and product teams to manage technical dependencies and operational risks. Evaluate Microsoft capabilities, third-party solutions, and emerging identity patterns based on security, reliability, usability, scalability, supportability, and cost. Experience with Microsoft Entra External ID or a comparable customer, partner, or external-user identity platform. Working knowledge of Azure infrastructure fundamentals, including subscriptions, networking, Key Vault, monitoring, logging, resiliency, and governance. Experience translating security, reliability, and application requirements into identity architecture, configurations, integrations, or engineering solutions. Experience supporting production services, including monitoring, alerting, troubleshooting, incident response, change management, root-cause analysis, and service reliability practices. Understanding of SRE concepts such as SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, incident management, post-incident reviews, automation, toil reduction, and continuous improvement. Strong understanding of identity security principles, least privilege, separation of duties, zero-trust concepts, and secure integration patterns. Experience with scripting, automation, APIs, infrastructure as code, or policy as code. Ability to assess operational risk, prioritize reliability improvements, and make sound technical decisions during incidents. Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to apply comparable identity, security, reliability, and operational concepts across Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform environments. Experience with AWS IAM, AWS Organizations, AWS KMS, Amazon Cognito, Google Cloud IAM, Google Cloud Identity, Google Cloud KMS, or comparable services. Experience defining service health metrics, SLOs, error budgets, operational readiness criteria, or reliability scorecards. Experience with identity governance, entitlement management, privileged identity management, access reviews, and joiner-mover-leaver processes. Experience with application modernization, API security, directory synchronization, Microsoft Graph, or identity automation. Experience with customer identity and access management, including registration, progressive profiling, consent, account recovery, and federation. Microsoft certifications such as Identity and Access Administrator Associate, Azure Administrator Associate, Cybersecurity Architect Expert, or comparable credentials.
